impact: Target cuts and tighter neocloud financing keep pressure on NBIS after its roughly 16% drop; Baird's $200 still implies big upside from about $129 if funding holds.
summary: Analysts cut price targets on Nebius after its Q3 report: Baird lowered its target to $200 from $340 and Piper Sandler to $148 from $185, both keeping their ratings. The cuts follow Nebius raising 2026 capex to about $27B and setting a preliminary 2027 capex target of $40B to $45B, despite Q3 revenue of $980.8M beating the $907.5M LSEG consensus. CoreWeave fell about 10% and IREN about 7% alongside Nebius on Thursday, and TheStreet reports banks are hesitating to fund neoclouds.
title: Baird cuts Nebius target to $200 from $340; Piper to $148
